sample.name: acrobat-sdk-js-dev-guide.pdf
sample.comparison: Title comparison ignores chapter prefixes, whitespace and punctuation; physical pages and hierarchy compared exactly. Parenthesis preservation covered independently. Saved PDF reopened with all 291 destinations unchanged.

checks: Real PDF.js extraction detects TOC and independently resolves incorrect printed numbers to 6,2,5
Editing title invalidates target, manual correction is explicit, selected bookmarks commit atomically
Saved PDF reopens with the three exact physical destinations
Out-of-range manual pages and stale document revisions cannot be applied
Smart TOC is translated in English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese
Cancellation leaves the document and existing bookmarks unchanged
One-click workflow, menu icon, cross-page select all, deselect, search and filtered selection generate all 35 entries
User Acrobat PDF: all 291 main contents titles, destination pages and hierarchy agree with its original outline via real PDF.js and matching worker
Packaged native OCR detects and extracts all three entries from an image-only contents page
Offline OCR of body headings independently corrects wrong printed labels to physical pages 5,2,4
One undo restores the original empty bookmark tree after OCR generation
MoMA image grid: 7/7 human-counted entries and all seven printed labels; Good Design offers actual PDF page 6 for printed page 8
French artistic annual report: 25/25 human-counted entries, including page-first labels and wrapped display headings
Traditional Chinese report: 6/6 contents labels; financial tables across all 45 pages are not auto-selected as contents
